BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on March 2, 2026, it repurchased 72,259 of its ordinary shares across various trading venues, with an aggregated volume-weighted average price of $117.3720. The highest price paid per share was $118.52 and the lowest was $115.67. These repurchases are part of CRH's intention to buy back up to $300 million in ordinary shares by April 28, 2026, following its announcement on February 18, 2026. Following these transactions and subsequent cancellation, CRH will have 669,876,344 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury, representing 5.052% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 3 rd March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 2 nd March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.052% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
